title: docs: add guidelines for widget and common tests
body:
**Summary**

This PR adds a section on the contributing guidelines, documenting how to write tests for InstantSearch widgets.

In addition, it adds a common test suite for Breadcrumb's base behavior as an example that contributors can use for their own needs.

FX-2066

> **Note**
> Because this PR has 2 scopes, instead of squashing, after review I can rewrite the history to keep scoped commits and merge both of them into the main branch.
